mri_findings.Description: Specific MRI findings or lesion description. Abbreviations: L=left, R=right, B=bilateral, F=frontal, P=parietal, T=temporal, MTS=mesial temporal sclerosis, FCD=focal cortical dysplasia, PMG=polymicrogyria

interictal_eeg.Description: Interictal EEG findings localization. Abbreviations: L=left, R=right, B=bilateral, F=frontal, P=parietal, T=temporal, FP=frontoparietal, FT=frontotemporal, PO=parietooccipital, TP=temporoparietal

location_of_resection.Description: Anatomical location of surgical resection. Abbreviations: L=left, R=right, F=frontal, P=parietal, T=temporal, PO=parietooccipital, ATL=anterior temporal lobe

engel_outcome.Description: Engel surgical outcome score or surgical status
